result: I’d make power over others require ongoing, enforceable consent from the people affected by it—not one-time elections, not theoretical consent, not “trust us.” Real, revocable say. Most of the world’s worst patterns are what happens when some people can decide for others without consequence. If that asymmetry were structurally impossible, a lot of other problems would stop being uphill battles.
